config.interval: pointwise 95% posterior predictive under the through-origin linear model
config.coverage: one independent held-out noisy observation per seed per location; same test noise across n
config.probe_prior: equal weights on signs -1,+1; each branch has Gaussian slope posterior from first 32 seed-zero samples
config.probe_rng: random.Random(200000+training_seed); shared probe noise across locations
config.probe_cost: not deducted; diagnostic experiment, not a cost-optimized exploration policy
